questions.question: In a right-angled triangle, the hypotenuse is 65 cm and one of its sides is equal to 16 cm. What is its area (in cm²)?
questions.solution:
**Detailed solution:-**

As we know,

Hypotenuse = H, Base = B, and Perpendicular = P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e428a1b7738441573ac77aa8bb6c15ad40d967a82a6eb98a96c1d8a6e7353f0.png] 

⇒ H² = B² + P²

⇒ B² + 16² = 652 

⇒ B² + 256 = 4225

⇒ B² = 4225 – 256

⇒ B = √3969

⇒ B = 63

As we know,

Area of triangle = (1/2) × Base × Height

Area of triangle = (1/2) × 63 × 16 = 504 cm²

questions.question: If 4 men can reap a field in 5 days working 12 hours a day, in how many days can 10 men reap the same field working 8 hours a day?
questions.solution:
As we know,

M₁ × T₁ × D₁ = M₂ × T₂ × D₂

4 × 5 × 12 = 10 × 8 × D₂

D₂ = (4 × 5 × 12) / (10 × 8)

D₂ = 3 days

questions.question: The mean proportional between 54 and 6 is x, and the fourth proportional of 2, 3, 12…….. is y. What is x : y?
questions.solution:
If mean proportional between 54 and 6 is x, then

54 : x ∷ x: 6

54/x = x/6

x² = 54 × 6 = 9 × 36

x = 3 × 6

x = 18

If fourth proportional of 2, 3 and 12 is y, then

2 : 3 ∷ 12 : y

2/3 = 12/y

y = (12 × 3) /2

y = 18

Ratio of x : y = 18 : 18 = 1 : 1

questions.question: If the 9-digit number 5x82y6588 is exactly divisible by 99 (x + y < 10), then what is the value of (y – x)?
questions.solution:
If the 9-digit number 5x82y6588 is exactly divisible by 99 so we can say number also divisible by 9 and 11.

Divisibility law of 9 ⇒ A number is divisible by 9 if the sum of its digit is divisible by 9.

Divisibility law of 11: If the difference of the alternating sum of digits of the number is a multiple of 11 (e.g. 2343 is divisible by 11 because (2 + 4) – (3 + 3) = 0, which is a multiple of 11).

(5 + 8 + y + 5 + 8) – (x + 2 + 6 + 8) = 11

26 + y – 16 – x = 11

y – x = 11 – 10

y – x = 1

questions.question: A train takes 1 hour 10 min to travel between two stations P and Q. If it travels at 5/7 of its usual speed, what time will it take to travel between P and Q?
questions.solution:
Let the speed of the train be 7 unit

Decreased speed of the train to cover the distance between P and Q = 7 × (5/7) = 5 unit

Speed ratio = 7 : 5

As we know, time is inversely proportional to speed.

Time ratio = 5 : 7

5 unit = 1 hr 10 min = 70 min

1 unit = 70/5 = 14 min

7 unit = 14 × 7 = 98 min or 1 hr 38 min

questions.question: Seven copies of a book can be bought for the certain sum payable at the end of a year and eight copies of the same book can be bought for the same sum in ready money; what is the rate percentage (correct up to two decimal places) of interest?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Amount of 7 copies bought by paying the amount at the end of the year = Amount of 8 copies at ready cash

**Concept used:**

Simple interest = PRT/100

**Calculation:**

Let CP of each of seven books be Rs. 1.

Total money for 7 books = Rs 7

Principle = Rs. 7

Total money for 8 books = Rs 8

Extra amount paid = interest on the 7 books = 8 - 7 = Rs 1

Interest at the end of the year = Rs. 1 = 1 book

Rate of interest = (1/7) × 100 = 14.29%

**∴ The rate of interest is 14.29%.**

questions.question: When the price of sugar gets raised by 20%, a person increases his expenditure on sugar only by 12%. By what percentage (correct up to two decimal places) should he reduce his consumption of sugar so as to be able to maintain the same level of expenditure?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

When the price of sugar gets raised by 20%, a person increases his expenditure on sugar only by 12%

**Calculation:**

Let the price of sugar be Rs.100

Price of sugar after increment of price = 100 × 120 / 100 = Rs.120

The person wants to increase his expenditure only by = 100 × (112 / 100) = Rs.112

The ratio of the increased price of sugar and the price of sugar according to the increased expenditure

= 120 : 112

As we know, the consumption of sugar is inversely proportional to the price.

The ratio of consumption of sugar in both cases = 112 : 120

Percentage reduction in his consumption of sugar so as to be able to maintain the same level of expenditure by = [(120 – 112) /120] × 100 = 6.67%

questions.question: If 0° ≤ ∅ ≤ 90°, and cos∅ + sec∅ = 2, then ∅ is equal to:
questions.solution:
cos∅ + sec∅ = 2

cos∅ + 1/cos∅ = 2

cos²∅ + 1 = 2cos∅

cos²∅ – 2cos∅ + 1 = 0

(cos∅ – 1)² = 0

(cos∅ – 1) = 0

cos∅ = 1 = cos 0

∅ = 0°

**Alternate Solution:**

cos∅ + sec∅ = 2

∅ = 0°

cos0° + sec0° = 2

1 + 1 = 2

2 = 2 (satisfied)

questions.question: The area of the curved surface of a right circular cylinder is 17.5 m² and its volume is 14 m³. What is the radius of its base?
questions.solution:
As we know,

The curved surface area of cylinder = 2 πrh

2 πrh = 17.5

rh = 17.5/2π ...1)

Volume of cylinder = πr²h

πr²h = 14

rh = 14/πr ...2)

From equation (1) and equation (2)

17.5/2π = 14/πr

r = (14 × 2) /17.5

r = 1.6 m

questions.question: If x – 1/x = 7, then what is the value of (x³ – 1/x³)?
questions.solution:
x – 1/x = 7

As we know,

(x – 1/x)³ = x³ – 1/x³ – 3 (x – 1/x)

7³ = x³ – 1/x³ – 3 × 7

x³ – 1/x³ = 343 + 21

x³ – 1/x³ = 364

questions.question: In an innings, the average of the first 6 batsmen is 50, while that of the latter 5 batsmen is 20. If the scores of three batsmen from the first lot and three from the latter are swapped, the average of its first six becomes 40, then what would the average of latter five become?
questions.solution:
Average scores of first 6 batsmen = 50

Sum of scores of first 6 batsmen = 50 × 6 = 300

Average of next 5 batsmen = 20

Sum of scores of next 5 batsmen = 20 × 5 = 100

Sum of scores of all 11 batsmen = 300 + 100 = 400

New average scores of first 6 batsmen = 40

Sum of scores of first 6 batsmen = 40 × 6 = 240

Sum of scores of next 5 batsmen = 400 – 240 = 160

Average scores of next 5 batsmen = 160/5 = 32

questions.question: What is the average of all natural numbers from 101 to 200?
questions.solution:
**Short Trick:**

Remember the result that the average of any consecutive series is the median.

So average from 101 to 200 = 150.5

**Detailed Solution:**

As we know,

Sum of first n natural number = [n (n + 1)] /2

Sum of first 200 natural number = (200 × 201) /2 = 20100

Sum of first 100 natural number = (100 × 101) /2 = 5050

Sum of the numbers from 101 to 200 = 20100 – 5050 = 15050

Average of the numbers from the 101 to 200 = 15050/100 = 150.5
